title: Operational Decarbonisation Supports Enterprise Economic Resilience Across European Commercial Fishing Fleets in a Longitudinal Panel Assessment (Replication Code)
description: Complete Python data-handling, cleaning, bio-economic fusion, panel econometric estimation, carbon tax/rebate micro-simulation, and publication visualisation codebase for Operational Decarbonisation Supports Enterprise Economic Resilience Across European Commercial Fishing Fleets in a Longitudinal Panel Assessment. Primary datasets are publicly available from the European Commission JRC/STECF Annual Economic Report (AER), ICES Stock Assessment Database, FAO GFCM, OECD FSE, Eurostat, and World Bank WDI repositories.
